description: GENESYS-2 is a framework listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Frameworks", published or maintained by RWTH Aachen University Institut ISEA, RWTH Aachen University Institut IAEW. Optimisation of the development corridor from today till 2050 under political boundaries like co2 emission targets, emission certificate prices (that are set in the framework);Standard parametrisation of several European countries Operation and unit dispatch on hourly basis of the whole optimisation time span;Time series for Renewable Energy Generation with support for lookup table to simulate ... Coverage: Global, Regional, National. Methodical focus: Energy demand, Energy supply, Environmental, Modular build-up, Energy dispatch, Capacity expansion planning, Unit commitment, Rule based operation management. Software: C++, Python used for result analysis. Initial release: 2017-01-01. The listed link gives the project or repository page; nothing was installed or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is GNU LGPL. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
